messages:
Noah (Finance): FYI spike on Customer 'OrbitAI' Feb bill: embeddings billed = 4,150,000 but usage lake shows 3,100,000. ~1.05M difference. Can billing + SRE triage?
Ivy (Billing): on it. Do we have the invoice id?
Noah (Finance): INV-ORBIT-202602-02 line 4. Amount diff looks ~ $420 (at $0.0004/unit) but want root cause first.
Elena (Customer Support): OrbitAI opened ticket saying they had a client-side retry flood after a transient 503 from our edge. They attached timestamps and client_request_ids.
Rakesh (SRE): quick check of metering logs shows a backfill run around 2026-02-27 that moved events from raw_events -> metering_events. metering-bot reported success. I'll paste the run summary.
metering-bot: job=backfill-raw-to-meter-20260227, started=2026-02-27T02:10Z, processed=1,980,210, inserted=1,980,210, dup_keys_detected=0
Rakesh (SRE): digging logs — there was a retry loop in the backfill workers that re-played some batches between 02:15 and 02:23Z due to a transient S3 list timeout. Dedup key landed in codebase on 2026-03-01. commit: git/commit/ba5f9c2.
Ivy (Billing): so possible double-insert before dedupe existed. Can you check OrbitAI's partition for duplicated event_ids?
Rakesh (SRE): ran a partition-level dedupe query:

```
SELECT count(*) FROM metering_events
WHERE customer='orbitai' AND month='2026-02' AND is_duplicate=TRUE;
-- result: 1,046,712
```
Rakesh (SRE): that matches your delta. Looks like duplicates were flagged by our later dedupe pass.
Noah (Finance): good find. Ivy, recommend issuing credit? Also need sign-off and GL code.
Ivy (Billing): prepping credit memo draft. Estimated amount = 1,046,712 * $0.0004 = $418.6848 -> round to $418.68. Requesting Priya approval.
Priya (Finance Manager): approve $418.68 credit for INV-ORBIT-202602-02. GL: BILL-ADJ-2026-02. Note: cause = backfill worker retry double-ingest; fix deployed commit ba5f9c2.
Ivy (Billing): created credit memo CM-8117 $418.68, applied. Marked status: applied. Notified OrbitAI via support thread.
Elena (Customer Support): customer response: "Thanks, appreciate fast resolution." :tada:
Rakesh (SRE): follow-ups: 1) run org-wide scan for duplicates and produce list of impacted customers (job dup-scan-20260304) 2) add alert on backfill retry rate 3) include short note in billing FAQ about backfill adjustments.
Noah (Finance): add reconciliation item to monthly ops agenda. Thanks team.
Ivy (Billing): resolving this thread for OrbitAI; will reopen if more impacted customers surface.
